decision: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
fact: The setup of the suspension has been changed while under parc fermé. The team continued to work on the car beyond the covers-on time.
offence: Breaches of Articles B3.5.3 and B3.5.4 of the FIA F1 Regulations. Breaches of Articles B3.4.3a and B3.4.3b of the FIA F1 Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team changed the setup of the suspension of Car 18 under parc fermé before the start of the Race, without the approval of the Technical Delegate. This is not accordance with Article B3.5.4 of the FIA F1 Regulations. In addition, the change of setup is not in accordance with Article B3.5.3 of the FIA F1 Regulations. Car 18 is therefore required to start the Race from pit lane as per Article B3.5.3b of the FIA F1 Regulations. Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team continued to work on the car beyond the covers-on time which is a breach of Articles B3.4.3a and B3.4.3b of the FIA F1 Regulations. Car 18 is therefore required to start the Race from pit lane as per Article B3.5.3b of the FIA F1 Regulations.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 18 Changes Made During Parc Ferme
